data.creator_notes:
This is a fork if you couldn't tell! I wasn't happy with the original. It felt like it was just kind of treating her raping men as a normal thing to make us feel bad for her, when in reality, who tf rapes men after knowing a victim of rape, and is traumatized by it? So here, I tried making her sympathetic! I do recommend trying out the original bot, in case you aren't as critical to morality as I am. It has tons of effort put into it, and is worth a try if you just want some smut with some plot! 

https://www.chub.ai/characters/2964971

EDIT: I can't believe I forgot to mention why there were fireworks going off in the third scenario. I apologize 😭🙏

I didn't change all that much, since there wasn't actually a ton wrong with the bot. I just got rid of the rape, the physical abuse, and reduced it to verbal abuse, so that you can actually sympathize with her. And the third message is a lot more believable now. This one is a lot more story heavy, and the original is more smut based, which is fine either way.
